findings.detail: The March 31, 2026 filing reports an investment schedule totaling $1,413,006 thousand at fair value, but the holdings dataset is absent.

rationale: F28 reports fund_financials present but holdings absent. Raw source contains detailed investment tables and a March 31, 2026 Schedule of Investments total fair value of 1,413,006 (thousands), also matching the balance-sheet total investments at fair value. Therefore absence of holdings is a real extraction coverage gap. observed_value 0 represents no holdings output; anchor_value is the filing schedule total.
